summary: Audit 2026-10-05 C12 brain crash safety, with both independent reviews and the Copilot review addressed: journaled full-save swap rolled forward after a crash only while HEAD holds no newer state (only brain-owned files count: foreign files such as .DS_Store are ignored and never deleted; a timestamp sentinel blocks the roll-forward only where checksums cannot decide); a stale journal is retired with a forensic copy, HEAD kept and a durable .full_save_required marker written until a full save commits; a missing file that HEAD held before the swap falls back to the newest complete backup; a generation rolled forward after a backup fallback is copied into backups/ before any save replaces it; generation inventory rejects missing, unsigned or torn listed files (backup fallback); after a fallback the engine takes a full save and never backs up or essential-saves into a rejected HEAD; ml_state.json written once per save; essential saves report OSError and never publish an ensemble under the research lock; standalone exit-level write settles a pending journal and is skipped when it cannot; read-only unsigned-pickle pre-deploy check (symlinked pickles are errors); trained-overwrite guard; unsigned pickles never deserialized; saves that did not happen are reported; renames fsynced

risks: 3 organism file(s) changed — replay verification required
Brain persistence only (not frozen surface, no trading decision, parameter, model byte or fingerprint change; runtime_config_snapshot unchanged).

A full save no longer deletes files in organism_brain that are not brain-owned (previously every non-preserved entry was swapped out): foreign files such as .DS_Store or operator copies stay in HEAD; they are never loaded.

New HEAD file .full_save_required (written only when a stale journal is retired, removed by the next committed full save or roll-forward). Older code ignores it on load and removes it on its own full save; it is copied into engine backups and the host archive with the HEAD it describes.

After a backup fallback caused by a busy brain lock, a full save is refused (reported, CRITICAL every third failure) while the rolled-forward generation cannot be copied into backups/ (e.g. disk full).
Under the research lock an essential save no longer publishes a changed ensemble; with frozen models HEAD already holds the content, and the next full save writes it in its journaled swap.
follow_ups: Known limit 'partial ensemble publication' (PR description): _publish_ensemble is now documented as not crash-safe and never used under the research lock. Before the lock is lifted, give changed ensembles a recoverable generation-level commit (or route them through the journaled full save) and add a crash test inside that publication.

Second review P3 (_save_ml_models): a full save still stages and publishes a partially serialized ensemble when a pair fails to pickle (a serialization failure, not a crash); raise when a trained ensemble cannot be fully serialized. Inert under the research lock.

Known limit 'startup lock timeout' (PR description): load still proceeds without the brain lock after 20 s and runs on the newest backup while a journal is pending. The interrupted generation is now copied into backups/ before any save replaces it, but restoring it is a manual decision; consider waiting longer or retrying once before that fallback when a journal is present.

Second review P3 (live_engine._save_brain): when full_save_required() is set and the forced full save fails, the cycle persists nothing; fall back to save_essential_state in the same cycle when brain._head_rejection_reason() is None (a HEAD kept over a stale journal, or a journal that can be settled).

Second review test gap: a behavioural test for the path where _loaded_from is the only rejection signal (fallback from a HEAD without an inventory, e.g. an unsigned main model, then a refused essential save and a gated full save); mutant M3 is still killed only by a message assertion.

Optional docs (second review): mapss sections 15/48 still say 'IF gate rejects -> DO NOT SAVE'; describe the journaled swap, inventory rejection, the full-save triggers and .full_save_required. No trading invariant changed, so AGENTS.md does not require it.
